# Thomas Huang

> Personal site of Thomas Huang, a backend software engineer. It hosts a coffee brew journal, a small shop of secondhand goods, and occasional blog posts.

## Pages

- [Home](https://www.thomhuang.com/): Introduction, resume link, and contact details.
- [Coffee journal](https://www.thomhuang.com/coffee): Brew logs grouped by roaster and coffee, with recipes and tasting notes. Each entry also has its own page at `/coffee/{id}`.
- [Shop](https://www.thomhuang.com/shop): Listings for items for sale, with photos, measurements, and prices. Each listing also has its own page at `/shop/item/{id}`.
- [Blog](https://www.thomhuang.com/blog): Posts by category. Each post also has its own page at `/blog/post/{id}`.
- [Policies](https://www.thomhuang.com/policies): Returns, shipping, terms of service, and privacy.

## Notes

- The site is a client-rendered single-page app; the pages above load their content from `https://www.thomhuang.com/api/*`.
- Pages under `/blog/entry`, `/coffee/entry`, `/shop/entry`, and `/shop/orders` are admin-only.
